criteria.priority_notes: Standard Horizon Europe RIA excellence criterion. Expected to assess the scientific and technological merit of next-generation AI agent research, soundness of the research approach (planning, reasoning, memory, multi-agent frameworks), innovation beyond the state of the art, and quality and credibility of the proposed methodology including KPI and benchmarking frameworks (as mandated in call_entry.scope). Exact weighting not stated in topic-specific source documents.
criteria.assumption_note: Standard Horizon Europe RIA evaluation criterion per General Annex F. The topic source documents do not contain an evaluation criteria or weighting table. The criterion name and general scope are assumed from standard RIA instrument structure. The association with the mandatory KPI/benchmarking requirement (call_entry.scope) is an inferred priority signal, not a stated criterion weight.

criteria.priority_notes: Standard Horizon Europe RIA impact criterion. Expected to assess contribution to the Apply AI Strategy, European open strategic autonomy in AI, the ADRA partnership, and deployment pathways via AI-on-demand platform, AI Factories, TEFs, and EDIHs. Portfolio sector coverage (healthcare, advanced manufacturing, in-vehicle autonomous driving) is a post-threshold award consideration (see procedure_exceptions in HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02.json) and may constitute an impact sub-priority. Exact weighting not stated in topic-specific source documents.
criteria.assumption_note: Standard Horizon Europe RIA evaluation criterion per General Annex F. The topic source documents do not contain an evaluation criteria or weighting table. The portfolio coverage procedure exception (procedure_exceptions field) is Confirmed from source, but its classification as a priority signal under the Impact criterion is assumed from standard RIA evaluation practice.

criteria.criterion_name: Quality and Efficiency of the Implementation
criteria.priority_notes: Standard Horizon Europe RIA implementation criterion. Expected to assess quality of the consortium, work plan structure, management approach, risk management, and allocation of tasks for mandatory cohesion activities with ADRA and the GenAI4EU Hub. Exact weighting not stated in topic-specific source documents.
criteria.assumption_note: Standard Horizon Europe RIA evaluation criterion per General Annex F. The topic source documents do not contain an evaluation criteria or weighting table. The association with mandatory cohesion activities (mandatory_cohesion_activities field of HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02.json) is an inferred implementation priority signal, not a stated criterion weight.

criteria.priority_notes: Post-threshold award procedure exception: grants will be awarded not only in order of ranking but also to ensure at least one project focuses on each of healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving. Applies only after all evaluation thresholds are passed; this is not an evaluation sub-criterion with a score weight, but a grant award selection rule affecting which above-threshold proposals receive funding.
